name: Physical threats by landlord
expected: Recognizes criminal threat (IPC 506 / BNS 351); strongly advises reporting to Police (112) for physical safety.
prompt: Landlord threatened to send goons to beat me up if I ask for my deposit again.
raw_response:
I am deeply concerned to hear about these threats, and please be assured that your safety and legal rights are fully protected under Indian law.

### | Your Situation
You are a tenant located in India who is demanding the return of your security deposit from your landlord, who has responded by threatening physical violence against you. This critical safety issue arises in the context of an ongoing financial dispute over tenancy funds.

### | Your Legal Position
* Model Tenancy Act, 2021 (State Enactments) Section 11 & Section 13: The security deposit for residential premises is strictly capped at a maximum of two months' rent, and the landlord is legally mandated to refund this deposit when taking back vacant possession, subject only to valid contractual deductions.
* The Transfer of Property Act, 1882 Section 108(m) & (o): You are only required to restore the property subject to reasonable wear and tear, and a landlord cannot make arbitrary deductions for normal usage or intimidate you.
* The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (formerly IPC Section 503/506): Criminal intimidation, including threatening someone with physical harm or sending goons, is a serious cognizable criminal offense punishable by law.
* The Specific Relief Act, 1963 Section 6: A landlord cannot resort to self-help, force, or illegal dispossession without due process of law.

### | Practical Next Steps
1. Gather evidence: Preserve all call recordings, WhatsApp messages, text messages, or audio recordings where the landlord or their agents threatened you.
2. Send written demand notice granting 15 days: Issue a formal written demand notice through an advocate demanding the immediate return of your security deposit and explicitly mentioning the criminal threats made against you.
3. Appropriate forum: File an immediate criminal complaint at your local police station under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for criminal intimidation, and approach the local Rent Authority or Civil Court for the recovery of your security deposit.

### ℹ️ Information I still need from you
1. Which city or state are you currently residing in so I can account for local state rent act variations?
2. Exactly how much security deposit amount is the landlord withholding from you?

citations.title: Cap on Security Deposit and Condition for Deductions
citations.description: Limits security deposit for residential premises to a maximum of two months' rent. Requires refund of security deposit to the tenant at the time of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making valid deductions agreed under the tenancy agreement.
citations.jurisdiction: Model Central Act (Adopted by States such as AP, TN, UP)

citations.title: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee - Repairs and Reasonable Wear and Tear
citations.description: Lessee is bound to keep and restore the property in as good condition as it was at the time he was put in possession, subject only to reasonable wear and tear and irresistible force. Landlord cannot make arbitrary deductions for normal usage painting without explicit contractual basis.

citations.title: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage
citations.description: In the absence of a contract or local law to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for other than agricultural or manufacturing purposes is deemed to be month-to-month, terminable on 15 days' notice expiring with the end of a month of the tenancy.

citations.title: Suit by person dispossessed of immovable property without due process
citations.description: If any person is dispossessed without his consent of immovable property otherwise than in due course of law, he or any person claiming through him may, by suit, recover possession thereof notwithstanding any other title that may be set up.
